name: QuALITY
ability_definition: The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.

task_realism.reasoning: Reading a long natural-prose document (~5,000 tokens) and answering questions that require whole-text understanding resembles real work, such as digesting reports, articles, or briefs. Questions probe main ideas, relationships, and inferences rather than lexical matching. However, the source material is mostly fiction (Gutenberg-era sci-fi) and magazine articles. Workplace reading is dominated by memos, reports, manuals, contracts, and emails, so the tasks are only moderately representative.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: Testing is static and single-document, with unlimited time and no stakes. The system never needs to decide what to read, cross-reference multiple sources, or act on what it understood. The input distribution skews toward literary and journalistic English, not domain documents. The HARD subset does defeat skimming shortcuts, which is a realistic demand. Still, conditions are clean and curated compared with messy real-world reading.

construct_coverage.reasoning: It covers a meaningful breadth of comprehension within narrative and expository prose: details spread across the text, inference, character motivation, and gist. It omits several things: technical, procedural, and regulatory text; tables and structured documents; instruction-following comprehension; and the ability to articulate understanding in one's own words. It measures deep long-passage understanding well, but only within a limited genre slice.

format_match.reasoning: Inputs are genuine prose artifacts, which is a plus. Outputs, however, are forced four-way multiple choice, which does not occur in workplace reading. Real work requires summarizing, extracting relevant points, answering open questions, or acting on instructions. Multiple choice also allows elimination strategies that do not reflect real comprehension demands.

transferability_reasoning: QuALITY is one of the better 2022 tests of genuine long-document comprehension because it requires whole-passage understanding and resists skimming, so it captures a real core of the Written Comprehension ability. Transfer to workplace capability is limited by its fiction/magazine genre focus, static single-document conditions, and forced multiple-choice outputs. Real work instead involves technical and procedural documents and open-ended use of what was read.

2022.metric: accuracy (%) on the QuALITY test set
2022.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical adults whose work involves reading and understanding long-form prose, such as office, administrative and professional readers. They are assumed to read the full passage untimed.
